channel.title: 1000 Errors: Laser Cut Art & Light Sculptures
channel.description: Laser Cut Art & Light Sculptures by 1000 Errors.

item.title: Septagram LED Light Sculpture, Laser Cut Wood Mandala
item.description: Close-up of the Septagram's central heptagram lit in purple. Seven-pointed septagram light sculpture in 7 layers of laser cut wood, LED-lit, with a stand and wall hanging ring. 30–80cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Squircles: 3D Printed Shadow Lamp Design
item.description: Squircles, a standalone app for designing 3D printed lamps that cast patterned shadows, which began as a Blender add-on. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Layered Laser Cut Beetle Art
item.description: Building an app to add three-dimensional depth to beetle paintings with stacked, laser cut layers of card. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Sacred Geometry Laser Cut Light Art
item.description: The Seed of Life light sculpture, illuminated on its stand. Sacred geometry light art, laser cut from layered wood and illuminated with LEDs. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Lotus Flower of Life Lamp, Laser Cut Wooden Pendant Light
item.description: Close-up of the filament bulb glowing inside the Lotus Flower of Life lamp petals. 3D lotus lamp with the Flower of Life pattern in gold, silver or natural wood. Hangs from the ceiling or stands as a table or floor lamp. 38–115cm wide. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Hexstatic LED Light Sculpture, Flower of Life Wood Mandala
item.description: Grid of close-ups showing the Hexstatic light sculpture's colour changing LED options. Flower of Life inspired mandala in hexagon layers, laser cut from birch, hand painted and lit with adjustable LEDs. 35–70cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.
